title: Real-zero amalgamation forces polymatroid amalgamation
author: Kummer, Mario; Sawall, David
work: Three results related to the half-plane property of matroids

primary_locator.required_core: complete authored homogeneous stable/real-zero conversion, signed hyperbolicity-cone control, support truncation and polymatroid restriction construction

difficulty_reason: The proof must homogenize a putative real-zero amalgam, control the hyperbolicity cone under a signed substitution, and recover an M-convex support realizing both restrictions. These structural compatibility steps remain substantive after the standard stability facts are allowed (Section 3, Theorem 3.3 and preceding supporting results).
